note: The skills of hachej/boring-stack and where they come from. Install with the skills CLI (see install), never committed to an app. pstack, cursor-team-kit verify-this and Matt Pocock's writing-for-agents are NOT vendored: they are installed from their upstream repositories. Vendored skills (Emil Kowalski, noodle, shadcn, taste-skill) are copied as they are at these commits unless listed under changes.

sources.note: Installed from upstream. boring-mode is adapted from poteto-mode; its playbooks and the vendored copies this repository used to carry (including the figure-it-out pointer to boring-mode and the verify-this surfaces adapted to the app scaffold) are replaced by the upstream skills. adapted instead of vendored: productivity/grilling and wait-what, and the domain-modeling, wayfinder and diagnosing-bugs skills, into boring-pm and the boring-mode bug-fix playbook
every other skill of the repository: wrappers over other skills, or names already taken here (tdd, prototype, code-review and the like)
changes: boring-pm and boring-mode/playbooks/bug-fix.md: adapted from domain-modeling, grilling, wayfinder, wait-what and diagnosing-bugs (no files copied)
